original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR Analysis: SPR was performed using a SensiQ Pioneer instrument and a HisCap chip (three-dimensional hydrogel surface) with 3 channels in series as previously described [20]. Channel 1 was activated with NiCl2 and 10 × His-eIF4E was immobilized by injection into the running buffer (10 mM HEPES-NaOH, pH 7.5, 225 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, 0.1% Tween-20, and 5% Glycerol). The concentration was adjusted to about 600 RU. 50 μL of peptide was injected at 50 μL/min over a range of 10 concentrations in duplicate and random order (188 nM–4.0 μM) at 25 °C. The chip was regenerated in between each cycle with injection 500 mM EDTA followed by reactivation with NiCl2 and re-immobilization of 10 × His-eIF4E. The association rate (ka), dissociation rate (kd), and binding constant (Ka) were obtained by fitting to a 1:1 interaction model using global data analysis with the Qdat software, which employs the Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear regression algorithm.

(B) Peptide helicities as determined via CD spectroscopy in 5 mM sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.4, 25 °C. (C) In vitro inhibitory activities determined via PPI cat-ELCCA. (D) Tabulated helicity and IC50 values (presented as 95% confidence intervals) and SPR data.
